feed.title: General Motors (GM) Has One Operational US EV Battery Plant
feed.summary: General Motors (GM) now has only one operational US electric vehicle battery plant, reflecting a shift in its North American manufacturing strategy. This move suggests GM is prioritizing profitable trucks and near-term cash generation, potentially slowing its EV progress in North America, a key point for investors to consider.
